description: This file is a Go source file implementing a process collector for Darwin (macOS) systems in the Prometheus client library. It gathers process metrics such as memory usage, CPU time, open file descriptors, and limits.

classes.name: memoryInfo
classes.description: Struct to hold virtual size and resident set size memory metrics.

classes.name: processCollector
classes.description: Struct that collects process metrics for Darwin systems.

methods.name: processCollect
methods.description: Collects various process metrics such as start time, CPU usage, memory info, open file descriptors, and limits, and sends them to a channel.
